design_concept.rationale: Transitioning from a dark, aggressive theme to a pristine, light, and premium aesthetic. Merges 'Pit Crew' efficiency with Goan 'Susegad' (relaxation) lifestyle. Clean white surfaces act as a canvas for the vibrant Relay Orange.
design_concept.archetype: The Performance Pro (Light Theme Variant) - High contrast structural grayscale with electric orange triggers.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to communicate speed and precision.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for body text.

headings.usage: Use Black (900) for hero headlines to give a bold, racing-inspired stance.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for dense text and pricing.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter text-zinc-900
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-900

surfaces.cards: Flat design: bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

motion.lists: Staggered fade-up for 'How it works' and package inclusions.

layouts_and_grids.general_spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.
layouts_and_grids.hero: 2-column on desktop. Left: High-impact typography and CTA. Right: Premium car image overlapping a subtle structural grid background.
layouts_and_grids.trust_badges: 4-column grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) with gap-6. Icons centered above text.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Use for 'How it works'. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3. Alternating heights to break monotony.
layouts_and_grids.pricing: 1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 4-col desktop. Use Shadcn accordion for 'What's included' to keep cards from becoming infinitely long.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white hover:bg-[#E04F00] font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4

shadcn_overrides.card: Remove default soft shadows. Use crisp 1px borders.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Orange text on white must be large enough or darkened slightly if used for small body text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the theme is strictly light mode. Do not use dark backgrounds except perhaps for a contrasting footer or specific dark manifesto section.
Implement the 'Outfit' font for headings via Google Fonts or standard imports. Use Manrope for body text.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align for readability.
For the Wash Packages, MUST use Shadcn Accordion for the inclusions list to prevent massive card heights.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons, keeping them tinted to the brand orange.
Apply `data-testid` to all CTAs, navigation links, and package selection buttons.
Do not use generic `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
Missing image categories = use the provided URLs. DO NOT use placeholder text.
